corpora.title: ספריית אגודת חסידי חב״ד
corpora.notes: On 2026-11-13, five public Igrot Kodesh item pages were reviewed through search-visible Hebrew body excerpts. Direct page opens returned zero readable lines, so item-level records remain context_status=partial and claims are restricted to visible excerpts. One item is explicitly a free Hebrew translation of a Russian letter and is marked non-independent. Corpus-level Indexed status does not imply that all items or full page bodies are verified.

corpora.title: Igros Kodesh — The English Letters

corpora.notes: High-yield legal discovery layer for item-level video metadata. Individual pages can expose stable aid URLs, event dates, program/disc locators and related-text metadata. Copyright remains with the relevant publisher/JEM; ingest metadata and locators, not bulk protected media or transcripts.

corpora.title: Sichos Kodesh Audio
corpora.verified_metadata: The public Chabad.org/JEM index describes more than 4,700 audio recordings of the Rebbe's public addresses spanning 1951 through 1992, organized by year/date with stable item pages.
corpora.notes: External inventory only until bounded item-level ingestion. Preserve audio witness identity separately from edited/printed texts and Living Torah video excerpts; same-date records are linkage candidates, not assumed equivalents. Copyrighted audio is not bulk-copied.
